title: Enterprise knob intake, value-density scoring, and SLA-aware escalation playbook
creator: Marisol Reyes
description: Purpose: Define a repeatable intake and prioritization playbook for enterprise non-bug advisory requests that center on batching/caching knobs, quantization profiles, and routing policies. This ticket captures a proposed scoring algorithm, SLA-aware escalation lanes, ownership matrix, and operational runbook for hand-offs to Solutions Engineering and Runtime teams.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Documented scoring rubric that maps incoming signal attributes to Priority lanes (P0/P1/P2) and SLA timeboxes; 2) Triage flow implemented as a checklist in the intake form and validated with two enterprise customers; 3) Routing rules configured in the advisory queue that auto-assign to Solutions Eng for high-cost/high-regress risk tickets; 4) Playbook reviewed and approved by Product, Solutions Eng lead, and Runtime lead.
triage_flow: 1. Intake capture (customer -> Web form / Support ticket) collects: workload metadata, current model, QPS, token distribution, cost sensitivity, business impact, compliance flags, public datasets involved. 2. Auto-preprocessor enriches ticket with recent usage metrics and top-k latency/cost samples. 3. Value-density score computed (see scoring_formula). 4. Route: if security/compliance flag true => Security review lane; else if value-density >= 8 => Solutions Eng (P1) w/ 3-day SLA; else if potential quality regress risk high => Research review (P2) w/ 10-day SLA; else => Advisory backlog (P3). 5. Assignment triggers template-based tasks: benchmark harness, sample prompts, eval set, and required observability attachments.
scoring_formula: Value-density score = normalized_savings_estimate * 0.45 + SLA_risk_factor * 0.25 + customer_revenue_weight * 0.20 + rollback_complexity_penalty * (-0.10) where: normalized_savings_estimate = expected_token_cost_reduction / standard_bucket (0..10), SLA_risk_factor = (is_enterprise_sla?10:1..10 scale), customer_revenue_weight = log1p(ARR_kUSD)/max_log *10, rollback_complexity_penalty = estimated_engineer_days/5 scaled to 0..10. Score range 0..10. Thresholds: >=8 (P1), 5-7.9 (P2), <5 (P3).
metrics: Mean time to first response (enterprise P1): 3d
Percent of intake tickets auto-classified: target 65%
Reduction in per-token cost for accepted optimizations: target 12%
open_questions: What telemetry fields can we require from enterprise customers without creating friction?
Can Solutions Eng run benchmark tests on customer data in-situ or do we need synthetic fidelity harnesses?
Is billing-linked ARR metadata available in intake to compute revenue weight?
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): implement intake form changes, seed scoring algorithm offline and run on 30 historical tickets. Phase 2 (4 weeks): enable auto-enrichment pipeline and routing rules for pilot customers (2 enterprises). Phase 3 (2 weeks): iterate thresholds, integrate with Console dashboards and SLAs, train Solutions Eng. Phase 4: GA and add to runtime-1.18 playbook.
sample_ticket: Customer: VoxerCloud. Summary: High-latency for chat completion at 95th percentile and high per-token cost. Request: suggestions for batching and 4-bit quantization. Provided: model=redwood-40b-quant, avg QPS=12, peak=60, tokens per request median=160, ARR=120k USD. Auto-score=8.6 -> routed P1 to Solutions Eng. Action: created benchmark job, recommended batching window 50ms, quant profile q4_eco, follow-up A/B to measure quality delta.
